about: Companies whose own job boards are fetched on every run.
To add one, add {"name": "..."}: the run looks its board up on Ashby, Greenhouse and Lever.
When the lookup finds the wrong company, or the board is elsewhere, set "board" to ats:token,
where ats is ashby, greenhouse, lever, lever-eu or smartrecruiters and token is the slug in its URL.
A company without a readable board can carry "careers": the report lists it to check by hand.
To see what every entry resolves to, and how many jobs it has: node src/companies.ts
